note: FBP keeper model (logistic regression), trained on real keeper decisions before the 2022, 2024, 2025 and 2026 deadlines (920 players under contract). Inputs per player: FBP production that season, his next salary and contract, age, position and FantasyPros dynasty rank before the deadline. Backtest: 82.5% of decisions right, each year predicted from the others; team keeper value order matched the real order at 0.95-0.98. scripts/keepers.py applies it.
ceilingNote: Highest next-season salary ever kept at each position (keeper decisions 2021-2026). Above it the model's odds fall off: x e^(-dollars over / 10). No RB has ever been kept at $60+, even the RB1 (Ekeler 2022, McCaffrey 2025 at $63).
